description: Defines classes for managing permissions and permission categories within an enterprise RBAC system, including permission definitions, categories, and serialization methods.

classes.name: Permissions
classes.description: Main class that initializes and manages a collection of permission categories with predefined permissions.

classes.name: PermissionCategory
classes.description: Represents a category of permissions, containing multiple Permission objects.

classes.name: Permission
classes.description: Represents an individual permission with attributes such as name, description, and scope flags.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the permissions or categories into JSON format.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a Permission object to a PermissionCategory.
